independence_evidence: Self-published New York title sold through its own Shopify store; site footer and contact page name only Unemployed Magazine at 210 Lafayette Street, New York, with no parent group (https://www.unemployedmag.com/contact).
qualifies_reason: Independent New York print magazine whose Issue 08 went on sale 6 December 2025.
what_it_is: Unemployed is a large-format, image-led print magazine from New York built around commissioned fashion and art photography, with each issue redesigned around a theme (Issue 08 takes a deliberately classic magazine form, Issue 07 was 'Bad vs Good'). Issues appear roughly once a year in small runs and carry contributors from fashion photography and contemporary art. It is aimed at collectors of photography and fashion publications.
